title: How the account of a manufactured Owens–Kirk feud changed
summary: Tracks the displayed 2019 messages and Owens’s later challenge to their claimed Groyper provenance. Authorship, authenticity and alleged coordination remain unverified; this thread does not identify assassination participants.

milestones.label: Feud plan forwarded
milestones.proposition: An anonymous post forwarded through Kolvet and Erika was read by Owens as proposing a public feud between Owens and Kirk.
milestones.review_note: Reviewed 625–902 seconds and the canonical conveyance. The historical material is presented in this source; use its 2026-09-18 publication date, not the 2019 message date. Anonymous authorship and message authenticity are unverified; the proposal does not prove it was implemented.

excerpts: So it starts with this November 12th, 2019. And Andrew (Andrew Kolvet) says, just making sure you see this. And he forwards a message from E. ... milestones.label: Fabrication alleged
milestones.proposition: Owens later interprets the attacks as noncoincidental and accuses Kolvet and Erika of inventing the Groyper explanation while also claiming her friendship with Kirk had ended.
milestones.review_note: Reviewed 1080–1148 and 3733–3795 seconds. This expands her citation challenge into an attributed accusation; her earlier “maybe” speculation and “I don’t know” remain material caveats. The transcript does not authenticate the messages or prove authorship, coordination, a murder motive or assassination participation.
milestones.statement_text: Owens said she was revisiting her life and believed the attempts to turn people against her and Kirk were not coincidental; she accused Kolvet and Erika of making up the Groyper explanation.
milestones.speaker: Candace Owens

evidence.text: Owens said she was revisiting her life and believed the attempts to turn people against her and Kirk were not coincidental; she accused Kolvet and Erika of making up the Groyper explanation.
evidence.speaker: Candace Owens
excerpts: I agree with you. I am revisiting my own life and realizing that none of that stuff was by coincidence. ... I mean, obviously me and Charlie (Charlie Kirk) noticed it was happening and we're like, what's happening? Why are these random attacks happening? ... Time, and we just couldn't figure it out. And then we have this outside person at the time, Erika Frantzve, being like, oh, it's the Groypers. And Andrew (Andrew Kolvet)'s like, it's the Groypers, making up the Groypers. You're making it up. Well, Andrew (Andrew Kolvet), it can't be both. Did Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and I stop being friends in 2019, or did the Groypers make that up? It can't be both. You can't go back on that, man.

milestones.label: Unfollow explained as marketing
milestones.proposition: Owens denies that unfollowing Kirk showed a feud, explaining that she unfollowed everyone for a book announcement and saying she retains texts in which Kirk praised the marketing move.
milestones.review_note: Reviewed 3285–3339s and prior statement-398ee3c1566c / milestone-ep389-feud-fabrication-alleged with its source context. The immediately preceding Groyper reference explicitly connects this reply to the manufactured-feud narrative. Texts are claimed to be retained, not displayed or authenticated here; no book date, actual friendship status, provenance fabrication or authorship is independently established.
milestones.statement_text: Owens denied that her unfollowing Charlie Kirk reflected a conflict between them, saying she unfollowed everybody for a book announcement, retained text-message receipts and characterized Kirk as praising the move as brilliant marketing.
milestones.speaker: Candace Owens

evidence.text: Owens denied that her unfollowing Charlie Kirk reflected a conflict between them, saying she unfollowed everybody for a book announcement, retained text-message receipts and characterized Kirk as praising the move as brilliant marketing.

Now they're like, Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and Candace (Candace Owens). I'm following, I can't listen to follow Charlie (Charlie Kirk) because they had issues. ... It's just none of it is true and that's why none of it sticks. Only what is true can stick.

links.review_note: Statement-d8309156c32a gives Kolvet’s claimed origin for the same forwarded feud-plan material recorded by statement-4c60622613ac; it narrows the account of provenance without authenticating authorship.

Statement-8d400b6ca6e8 supplies the citation offered for the blog-provenance account in statement-d8309156c32a. A claimed citation is reviewable evidence of how the explanation developed, without validating that explanation.

Statement-1d07c544ed2b directly disputes the offered support in statement-8d400b6ca6e8, specifically whether the article linked this feud post. The incompatibility is between attributed accounts, not a resolved external fact.

The citation challenge in statement-1d07c544ed2b becomes the broader alleged-fabrication conclusion in statement-398ee3c1566c. This records the inferential change, preserving that the challenged link does not prove the accusation.

Statement-398ee3c1566c disputed manufactured claims that the friendship ended; statement-5a3d9f5c9e01 follows an explicit Groyper reference with a particular unfollow counterexplanation and claimed retained texts. It sharpens her rebuttal without validating friendship, the texts or the earlier fabrication accusation.
